propositions: The comment-hygiene gate is wired into CI but not into the local `make lint` target, causing divergence between local and CI verdicts and wasting review cycles.
The gate runs only in the full test suite locally via test_the_real_tree_is_clean, not in the fast `make lint` path.
The introducing ticket shows no deliberate intent to exclude the gate from `make lint`; its plan followed the scripts/check_*.py convention without discussing lint placement.
Adding the gate to `make lint` adds ~4.9s runtime (baseline 17.8s → ~22.7s), acceptable relative to 15-minute CI failures.

The gate must be wired into the `lint` target in the Makefile alongside `scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`, with a wiring test in test_comment_hygiene_guard.py that verifies the invocation and has removal teeth.
